items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: You mention [LaGranda] Mason and [LaGrande Mason's brother, what was his name?

ctx.x: He would come off the band stand with one pants leg rolled up like he had been riding a bicycle. That's where he was scratching. (Laughter.) But he could play that tenor.
